pivHint: God says he knows the PLANS he has for you, Jeremiah writes. A drawing of a building's layout is called a ______ plan.
winText: You found it. PLANS isn't just a word in today's verse — a drawing of a building's layout is a FLOOR plan.
lossText: The word was FLOOR. PLANS was the pivot — a drawing of a building's layout is a FLOOR plan.
votdVerse: For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
passageText: This is what the Lord says: “When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will come to you and fulfill my good promise to bring you back to this place. For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
